# Map the Brain Fleet client contract in the architecture inventory

## Context

Brain #217 is moving Fleet's pure vocabulary and wire helpers into canonical `src/fleet/contract/**`, exposed as `neo-agent-brain/fleet-contract`. Its implementation already passes the focused Fleet matrix and an isolated installed-package browser bundle.

## The Problem

The Engine-owned Architecture Overview maps the Brain's Fleet runtime under `ai/services/fleet/` but has no row for the new client-safe contract. Without a companion update, the inventory would leave readers looking in the runtime service tree for public definitions.

## The Architectural Reality

`learn/benefits/ArchitectureOverview.md` owns the cross-repository Structural Inventory. Its Agent OS table describes paths in the sibling Brain repository. Brain #193 establishes canonical domain source; ADR 0038 keeps client vocabulary separate from runtime trust and lifecycle services.

## The Fix

Add the Brain contract row to the Agent OS table and clarify that this table can contain Brain-owned `src/**` paths as well as `ai/**`. Keep the Engine runtime table and existing Fleet service row intact.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Agent OS inventory | Brain #217/#193 and ADR 0038 | Names the public package entry and Brain source home; distinguishes private runtime services | No local-copy or runtime-root import advice | Architecture Overview | Diff and verified producer source/exports |
| Root qualification | ADR 0040 two-root boundary | Agent OS table paths are explicitly Brain-relative | Engine `src/**` stays in its own table | Table introduction | Render/Markdown inspection |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The Agent OS table names Brain's `src/fleet/contract/` and `neo-agent-brain/fleet-contract`.
- [ ] The prose makes the repository boundary unambiguous.
- [ ] No runtime, generated file, or unrelated guide content changes.
- [ ] The companion PR links the producer; its documented interface matches that producer.

## Out of Scope

Contract implementation, Institution adoption, Fleet protocol changes, or a broader inventory rewrite.

Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0038 and ADR 0040; no amendment.

## Avoided Traps

Do not describe Brain's `src/fleet` as an Engine module. Do not copy the map into a consumer repository. Keep the inventory a pointer, not another API reference.
